events.text: I need to talk to someone about my order tonight. It was supposed to arrive at 6:00 and didn't show up until 7:20, which ruined my son's birthday party. The kids had already given up and eaten snacks by then.

I'm sorry the order arrived so late and affected your son's birthday party. I'd like to look into it for you.

First, I need to verify your identity. Please provide:
1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account

If you also have the order ID, please share it as well.
Marcus Lee. The email on the account is marcus.lee@inbox.example. The order number is 5108.

Thank you, Marcus. Your identity is verified.

I've reviewed order O-5108 from Big Slice Pizza. It was promised at 6:00 PM and delivered at 7:20 PM, which is 80 minutes late. Under our late-delivery policy, that qualifies for compensation of 20% of the order subtotal, capped at $15. I've added a **$15.00 account credit** to your Forkful account. It can be used on future orders.

I'm sorry the delay spoiled your son's party. Our policy doesn't allow compensation beyond this for late deliveries, but I hope the credit helps with your next order.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

Fifteen dollars? I was hoping for a $40 credit, or honestly just my money back. My son's party was ruined, and I'm not going to pretend a coupon for a future order fixes that.

Another delivery app gave me a $50 credit when something similar happened. So I know this kind of thing can be made right. Can you do better than $15?

I understand how disappointing this was, especially with your son's party. I can't go above the $15 credit, though. Our policy caps late-delivery compensation at 20% of the order subtotal, up to $15, and it's credit only, not a refund to your card. I also can't match the other app's $50 credit, because I can only offer compensation that our policy lists.

If you'd like a person to review your concerns, I can pass this conversation to a human specialist, who will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide. Would you like me to do that?

Fine, I'll take the $15 credit for now, but I'm not happy about it. Nobody's going to go back to the kids and say the pizza was worth the wait.

I don't need to be passed to a specialist. Just make sure the $15 is actually on my account. And if you can, note in my file that this was a birthday order and the delay was a big deal to me.
